statement.p: Consider the concentration, C, (in mg/liter) of a drug in the blood as a function of the amount of drug given, x, and the time since injection, t. For 0 \leq x \leq 5 mg and t \geq 0 hours, we have C = f(x,t) = 28te^{-\left(5-x\right)t}

Give a practical interpretation of your answer: f(3, 4) is
the change in concentration of a 3 mg dose in the blood 4 hours after injection.
the amount of a 3 mg dose in the blood 4 hours after injection.
the concentration of a 4 mg dose in the blood 3 hours after injection.
the concentration of a 3 mg dose in the blood 4 hours after injection.
the amount of a 4 mg dose in the blood 3 hours after injection.
the change in concentration of a 4 mg dose in the blood 3 hours after injection.
